items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Brown came late to the gig and I fired him

ctx.x: There are four tunes with Ron Carter and Mousie that sound really good. Who’s idea was it to get them on there? It’s a curious choice for a bass player and drummer for a Tristano-type record.
Probably Dick Katz and Orrin. We played at the Village Gate once with Ron and a drummer named Brown. [I] forget his first name.
